name: export_type_parameters
description: Project: export all TYPE parameters of loaded family types (FamilySymbols) in the given categories to a JSON file ON DISK (written by the C# gateway). Per type: typeId, familyName, typeName, category, and every type parameter as {value, raw} (same shape as export_instances). Only a summary returns through MCP. categories are OST_* tokens; outputPath is a caller-supplied absolute path. Lengths mm, angles degrees.
